cc:Work.dc:title: Sine-Gordon breather
cc:Work.dc:description:
Draw the known sine-Gordon breather as a static website illustration.
Dimensionless equation: phi_tt - phi_xx + sin(phi) = 0. phi(x,t) = 4 atan(sqrt(1-omega^2) sin(omega t) / (omega cosh(sqrt(1-omega^2) x))), omega = 0.8. Source: https://doi.org/10.1007/s42985-021-00084-w, equation (1). This illustrates an established solution, not a new research result.
Requires NumPy and Matplotlib only when regenerating the checked-in SVG.
